text:
carmen.ops: Alert — 8 H100s arrived at FRA depot, 2 failing power-on (AWB 8811223344, 8811223345). This reduces eu-dedicated-3 capacity for next batch window. Need RMA plan and quick routing.
vendor_ines: Sorry, opening RMA now. Depot photos and POST logs attached. We can hot-swap 2 units from our NL pool, ETA 30-50h depending on customs. Alternative: air from UK reserve ~28h but with surcharge.
leo-procure: Air ok if uplift < $3.5k/unit. If higher, prefer NL crossdock. We also need replacement S/Ns for pre-seeding.
max-sre: Losing 2 GPUs will push some model jobs into queue; can we shift non-critical traffic to us-west overflow? Need ETA before shifting.
vendor_ines: Forwarder flagged 8811223344 for incomplete commercial invoice. They can reissue; reissue + air surcharge quoted $3.2k/unit. If we split cost 50/50, we can do air and aim for ~28h.
carmen.ops: @vendor_ines please add CI and depot sheet to the RMA ticket and post replacement serials here once available. Also confirm whether replacements are new or refurbished.
tara-logs: Inventory tags show these serials under eu-dedicated-3. If replacements originate from NL reserve we'll tag eu-temp-3 and route via AMS crossdock. Pre-stage burn-in images and node configs.
leo-procure: Approve up to $3.5k/unit emergency uplift. If vendor asks for >$1.5k/unit from our side escalate to finance.
ops-bot: Notice: eu-dedicated-3 will show -2 GPUs from 2023-11-09T04:15Z until attach.
max-sre: Two ops notes: 1) if replacements are refurbished, require 6h burn-in; 2) run perf canary and rollback traffic if throughput drops >8%.
vendor_ines: RMA-2023-0788 created: https://rma.vendor/2023/0788 — docs uploaded, reissue requested. Provisional ETA 30h pending CI reissue. Will attach S/Ns and AWB reissue when done.
carmen.ops: If vendor covers reissue fees we prioritize air. If they request >$1.5k/unit from us, crossdock. Get the split in writing.
vendor_ines: We will cover paperwork fees. Proposing 50/50 on the forwarder air surcharge. Adding to RMA notes.
tara-logs: When S/Ns posted, share exact format for infra automation:
```
replace_serials: [H100-NL7001, H100-NL7002]
awbs: [8811223344-reissued]
route: ams-crossdock -> eu-dedicated-3
```
carmen.ops: Also note: if replacements are marked refurbished, tag pending-burnin and hold in staging for 8h before joining pool.
max-sre: I'll prepare a short scheduler tweak to reduce noncritical job concurrency during the attach.
vendor_ines: Update: CI reissued and uploaded to RMA. Provisional outbound ETA 26h. Will post S/Ns within 2h.
leo-procure: I'll loop in finance only if vendor asks for >$1.5k/unit.
carmen.ops: Great. Keep updates here and ping me if ETA slips beyond 36h. :thumbsup:
